title: Marlboro maker Altria considering takeover bid for Imperial Brands
summary_full: Shares in UK tobacco company jump by more than 14% on news US rival is looking into making offerBusiness live – latest updatesImperial Brands could become the next UK company to fall to a foreign takeover after its US rival Altria announced a possible bid for the tobacco firm.Altria, whose Philip Morris division makes Marlboro and Benson & Hedges cigarettes, told the City on Thursday that it was considering an offer. If made it was likely to be solely in cash, it said. Continue reading...
